events.title: Maker Mondays
events.description: A casual weekly gathering for makers, tinkerers, and creators to share projects, troubleshoot technical problems, and connect with the local DIY community.

events.title: Carla Salmon X Tristan Bancks Double Book Launch
events.source: Where the Wild Things Are Bookshop
events.description: An evening conversation with authors Carla Salmon and Tristan Bancks discussing their latest creative processes and writing journeys.

events.title: Women's Woodworking
events.description: A hands-on workshop focused on woodworking skills within the HSBNE makerspace community, designed for women interested in building and fabrication.

events.title: Sculptures & Sips: Mechanical Reef
events.description: An immersive evening where attendees engage with the intricate design and mechanical artistry behind the 'Mechanical Reef' project hosted by the Dead Puppet Society.

events.title: Mono 61: claire rousay and Peter Knight
events.location: Institute of Modern Art, Fortitude Valley
events.description: An experimental music performance featuring claire rousay and Peter Knight, exploring soundscapes in the atmospheric setting of the IMA.

events.title: Nicholas Aloisio-Shearer on Memento Hikikomori Curator talk
events.location: Institute of Modern Art, Fortitude Valley
events.description: Curator Nicholas Aloisio-Shearer discusses the themes and concepts behind the 'Memento Hikikomori' exhibition, providing insight into contemporary cultural isolation and art.
